user.title: Connect to doorstep
user.description: Enter the address of the doorstep dashboard, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

data_description.username: Only needed when doorstep sits behind a reverse proxy that asks for HTTP basic auth.
data_description.password: The password that goes with the username.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure doorstep
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the doorstep dashboard, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

data_description.username: Only needed when doorstep sits behind a reverse proxy that asks for HTTP basic auth.
data_description.password: The password that goes with the username.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to doorstep again
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {url} were refused. Enter ones the reverse proxy in front of doorstep accepts.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL without credentials or a query string.
error.username_required: A password needs a username to go with it.
error.invalid_auth: The username and password were refused.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to doorstep at that address.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that address, but it does not look like doorstep.

abort.already_configured: This doorstep instance is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The doorstep address has been updated.

add_parcel.name: Add parcel
add_parcel.description: Files a new parcel in doorstep, on its way. Fails if doorstep already has a parcel with that tracking number.

config_entry_id.name: Doorstep instance
config_entry_id.description: The doorstep to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel. Letters, digits, '-' and '_' only.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: The carrier, or the id doorstep knows it by if it is not listed. Without one doorstep cannot poll the parcel.

postcode.name: Postcode
postcode.description: The delivery postcode. DPD and PostNL need it to look a parcel up.

refresh_parcel.name: Refresh parcel
refresh_parcel.description: Has doorstep ask the carrier about a parcel now rather than at its next polling round. Returns doorstep's outcome and the parcel's record.

config_entry_id.name: Doorstep instance
config_entry_id.description: The doorstep to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel to refresh.

remove_parcel.name: Remove parcel
remove_parcel.description: Deletes a parcel's record from doorstep, including its history.

config_entry_id.name: Doorstep instance
config_entry_id.description: The doorstep to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel to remove.
